The function body is:
```
682: def _sanitize_path_parts(parts):
683:     sanitized_parts = []
684:     for part in parts:
685:         if not part or part == '.':

```

Consider the LOOP INVARIANT to be checked at the END of every iteration body of the for-loop (line 684) -- specifically, the state of `sanitized_parts` right after one of the three terminating paths of the iteration body completes (`continue` at line 686, `continue` at line 692 after the pop/append at line 689 or 691, or fall-through after the append at line 697).     INV(sanitized_parts) := all(not p.endswith('.') for p in sanitized_parts)

- `total_iterations_observed`: int -- total number of for-loop iterations completed across all 18 test calls (i.e., for each test, the number of iterations executed by the loop on line 684, summed).
